title: Application of Simulated Evaporation Shapes to Adaptive Reconstruction
content: Atom probe samples are known to deviate, sometimes significantly, from spherical apex shapes during evaporation of a specimen containing materials with different evaporation fields [1]. The ubiquitous reconstruction protocol relies on a geometric model to calculate reconstructed coordinates from detector coordinates, and this process requires the assumption of a spherical apex shape [2]. To take a significant step forward in reconstruction accuracy, a method which accommodates arbitrarily shaped specimens is required.
